annotations.title: DCF + Owner Earnings + Damodaran intrinsic value

description: Per-method intrinsic value per share (DCF on free cash flow, owner earnings, Damodaran two-stage), their equal-weight blend, Monte Carlo bounds and the implied gap to the current price. The blend is checked against the price before it is served: if it fails a check (not positive, more than 20x the price, a price older than five days, no price, or `currency_consistent`: statements left in a currency other than the USD price), the valuation fields are null, `withheld` is true, `checks.failed` names the check and the call is not charged. A value under 0.05x the price is served with the flag `iv_far_below_price`. A value built from statements converted to USD carries `fx` (`from` the filer's currency, `to` USD, `rate`, `rate_date`, `rate_type`) on `values.intrinsic_value_per_share` and each method input; `currency_unverified` in `checks.flags` means the statement currency is not known for this ticker, so the check did not run. A method with no value is null in `methods`, never 0, and `methods_unavailable` says why (`code`, `family`: negative_cash_flow, financial_company, withheld or missing_inputs, and the pipeline's `reason`). For a one-call answer with holders and a verdict, use /brief/{ticker}. (GET https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/intrinsic-value/{ticker} — 0.005 credits per call; works with no credentials up to 5 call(s)/day per address)
